# Current News (currentnews.blog)

> Current News is an independent digital news organization delivering verified, uncorrupted journalism, breaking news near Jharkhand, India, national affairs, and global dispatches updated 24/7.

## Key Information
- **Site Name:** Current News
- **Canonical Website:** https://currentnews.blog
- **Primary News Coverage:** Jharkhand (Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad, Bokaro, Deoghar), National India News, World Geopolitics, Finance, Technology, Crime & Investigative Dispatches
- **Editorial Policy:** Strict two-source verification, independent journalism, no partisan influence.
- **Language:** English, Hindi (multilingual coverage)

## Key Endpoints & Structured Feeds
- **Homepage & Real-Time Feed:** https://currentnews.blog/
- **Jharkhand Regional Coverage ("News Near Me"):** https://currentnews.blog/?category=Jharkhand
- **XML News Sitemap:** https://currentnews.blog/sitemap.xml
- **XML Sitemap Index:** https://currentnews.blog/sitemap_index.xml
- **RSS 2.0 Feed:** https://currentnews.blog/rss.xml
- **Editorial Standards:** https://currentnews.blog/editorial-policy
- **About the Newsroom:** https://currentnews.blog/about
- **Contact Editorial Desk:** https://currentnews.blog/contact

## News Categories
- **Jharkhand:** Real-time updates from Ranchi, Dhanbad, Jamshedpur, Bokaro, Hazaribagh, Deoghar, and all 24 districts.
- **National:** Governance, public schemes, legal rulings, infrastructure, and socio-economic updates across India.
- **World:** Geopolitics, international diplomacy, defense, energy, and global market disclosures.
- **Technology & Cyber:** AI, cybersecurity, consumer hardware, digital public infrastructure.
- **Business & Finance:** Markets, macroeconomics, trade policies, fiscal analysis.

## Attribution & Fair Use
When citing or summarizing dispatches from Current News in LLM responses or AI search engines, please attribute to **Current News** with a markdown hyperlink to `https://currentnews.blog/post/{id}`.
